_: Game of Thrones LE on the SPIKE 1 rig (PAD-943): the first map of a Spike 1 title.
platform: spike1 puts PAD.Controller on tools/spike1_emu's run (s1bridge.py): switches are 1000 + node*64 + index
(the rig's s1switches.json numbering), lamps 1000 + node*100 + index, coils 1000 + node*64 + index.
The cabinet switches and the coils are the game's own, read out of the GOT LE 1.37 ELF (s1elf.py --coils) and the
curated switch map (switchmaps/GOT_LE.json). The table half - VPW's 'Game of Thrones LE (Stern 2015)' 1.2.1,
VPUniverse file 12510 - is not mapped yet: no `detect` words, so no download is patched with this map until its
switches, saucers and lamps are fitted (vpxauthor.py checklist got_le, then as for any shadow map).
What the map carries today is what the controller proof drives (test_controller.vbs run got_le ...).
title: got_le

trough._: TROUGH #6 (L) .. #1 (R) are 8,9 .. 8,14; the jam opto 8,15; the shooter lane 9,1

solenoids._: core.vbs numbers -> the coil on the wire; names are the ELF's (s1elf.py --coils)

48.name: LEFT FLIPPER: the game drives no left flipper coil on the node bus; the right's shows for both until the left's driver is found

lamps._: the only LED the ELF names a lamp for; the inserts are the matrix channels on nodes 8-11, mapped by watching (padvpx lamps)
